newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steady with crude, Skikda still closed.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steady with crude, Skikda still closed.

text.p: NWE naphtha was notionally stable on Friday as crude drifted and bad weather kept the Skikda port closed again, dealers said.
Skikda port officials said on Friday they did not know when it would reopen as the weather was still bad.
At least three large naphtha ships are heard delayed at Skikda, and one of them has waited at least 10 days.
December swaps were heard traded at $223.25 cif NWE while February was heard done at $207. Numbers were thought to have slipped back by 50 cents or so since then.
